detail_text: Specifically, the sterility test dated 9/10/15 which was conducted by your contract laboratory determined that Lipo-C Injectable, lot # 17478 (Production date: 8/12/15, Beyond Use Date: 1/31/16) was not sterile. Subsequent speciation via Redacted [redacted] dated 9/22/15 which was also performed by the contract laboratory determined that the contaminating organism was Streptomyces galbus. An investigation performed by the contracting laboratory dated 9/3/15 documented that the source of the contamination was caused by "external error". A second sample tested for sterility from the same lot passed sterility testing. There was no documentation of an investigation by your firm into the initial failing sterility result or potential impact on lots of injectable drug products produced on the same date. For example, the following lots of injectable drug products were also produced on 8/12/15: Glutathione, 200mg/ml, lot#17477 GHRP-2/GHRP-6/Sermorelin,lot # 17475 GHRP-2/GHRP-6/Sermorelin,lot #17473
detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, 계약 시험실이 9/10/15에 수행한 무균시험에서 Lipo-C Injectable, lot # 17478 (Production date: 8/12/15, Beyond Use Date: 1/31/16)이 무균 상태가 아닌 것으로 확인되었다. 계약 시험실이 9/22/15에 Redacted [redacted]를 통해 후속 균종 동정을 수행한 결과 오염 미생물은 Streptomyces galbus로 확인되었다. 계약 시험실이 9/3/15에 수행한 조사에는 오염 원인이 ‘external error’라고 기록되어 있다. 같은 로트의 두 번째 검체는 무균시험에 적합했다. 업체가 최초 무균시험 부적합 결과 또는 같은 날 생산된 주사제 로트에 대한 잠재적 영향을 조사한 문서는 없었다. 예를 들어 다음 주사제 로트도 8/12/15에 생산되었다. Glutathione, 200mg/ml, lot#17477 GHRP-2/GHRP-6/Sermorelin, lot # 17475 GHRP-2/GHRP-6/Sermorelin, lot #17473
